parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same root cause: episode_page re-walks the cursor chain from the first page for every requested page number, making the import of P pages quadratic in API requests (and resumed runs replay earlier pages), which worsens rate limiting. Description A locates it primarily in sync.py with client.py as an alternative, and Description B in client.py, which is an allowed location.
